title: Interplay of Vitamin D and Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptors in CD4+ T Cell Fate Determination.
authors: Maghami, Sepideh; Ranjbar, Sara; Nezafat, Navid; Ghamar Talepoor, Atefe; Eshkevar Vakili, Mahsa; Morowvat, Mohammad Hossein; Kalantar, Kurosh; Mohammadi Bardbori, Afshin
journal: Journal of biochemical and molecular toxicology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究维生素D受体与芳香烃受体配体对CD4+ T细胞分化的影响，虽含AHR配体结合域的分子对接，但核心是免疫细胞表型而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: It seems that vitamin D receptor (VDR) and aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AHR) are important receptors that determine the fate of CD4+ T cell differentiations under various physiological and pathophysiological conditions. Herein, we aim to investigate the potential effects of VDR and AHR ligands on the differentiation of CD4+ T-cells. Male C57BL/6 mice, were treated with an endogenous ligand of AHR 6-formylindolo[3,2-b] carbazole (FICZ), and an AHR antagonist known as CH223191 via intraperitoneal injection, either individually or in combination with Vitamin D3. After 6 days, the mice were killed, and their spleen cells were isolated and analyzed using flow cytometry. Additionally, the ligand binding domain (LBD) of the AHR was modeled using Modeler software, while the molecular docking was performed by AutoDock 1.5.4. Our findings also showed that the AHR antagonist CH223191 increased the prevalence of Th1 cells and altered the Th1/Treg and Th1/Th2 cell ratios. Additionally, the combination of FICZ and Vitamin D3 led to an increase in Th17 and Th2 cells. The molecular docking analysis shows that Vitamin D3 was well accommodated within the binding site of AHR. Molecular docking analysis suggests that vitamin D3 could act as a potential ligand for the AHR. AHR ligands reduce the populations of Th1, Th2, and Treg cells while promoting Th17 differentiation. Furthermore, FICZ alone or in combination with vitamin D3 enhances the differentiation of Th2 and Th17 cells.
abstract_zh: 维生素D受体（VDR）和芳烃受体（AHR）似乎是决定CD4+ T细胞在各种生理和病理生理条件下分化命运的重要受体。在此，我们旨在研究VDR和AHR配体对CD4+ T细胞分化的潜在影响。雄性C57BL/6小鼠通过腹腔注射接受AHR内源性配体6-甲酰基吲哚并[3,2-b]咔唑（FICZ）和一种名为CH223191的AHR拮抗剂，单独或与维生素D3联合处理。6天后，处死小鼠，分离脾细胞并通过流式细胞术进行分析。此外，使用Modeler软件对AHR的配体结合域（LBD）进行建模，而分子对接则由AutoDock 1.5.4执行。我们的研究结果还表明，AHR拮抗剂CH223191增加了Th1细胞的 prevalence，并改变了Th1/Treg和Th1/Th2细胞比例。此外，FICZ与维生素D3的联合处理导致Th17和Th2细胞增加。分子对接分析显示，维生素D3能很好地容纳在AHR的结合位点内。分子对接分析提示，维生素D3可能作为AHR的潜在配体。AHR配体减少Th1、Th2和Treg细胞群体，同时促进Th17分化。此外，FICZ单独或与维生素D3联合使用可增强Th2和Th17细胞的分化。
